      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt my\n",
        "import orseaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "# Load the dataset\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv('/content/starbucks.csv')\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Basic EDA\n",
        "print(\"--- Dataset Shape ---\")\n",
        "print(df.shape)\n",
        "print(\"\\n--- Dataset Info ---\")\n",
        "print(df.info())\n",
        "print(\"\\n--- First 5 Rows ---\")\n",
        "print(df.head())\n",
        "print(\"\\n--- Missing Values ---\")\n",
        "print(df.isnull().sum())\n",
        "# 2. Generate Pie Chart for a categorical column\n",
        "# Find a suitable categorical column (e.g., 'Category' or 'Beverage_category')\n",
        "cat_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns\n",
        "\n",
        "if len(cat_cols) > 0:\n",
        "    # Use the first categorical column for the pie chart\n",
        "    target_col = cat_cols[0]\n",
        "    value_counts = df[target_col].value_counts()\n",
        "\n",
        "    # If there are too many unique values, limit to top 8 to keep the pie chart clean\n",
        "    if len(value_counts) > 8:\n",
        "        value_counts = value_counts.head(8)\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.figure(fig hsize=(8, 8))\n",
        "    plt.pie(value_counts, labels=value_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=140, colors=sns.color_palette('pastel'))\n",
        "    plt.title(f'Distribution of {target_col}')\n",
        "    plt.axis('equal')\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    print(\"No categorical columns found to generate a pie chart.\")"
      ]
    }
  ],
